text_block_list.text:
It was decided that Sakura Laurel would 
enter the Hanshin Daishoten. Her goal: a 
showdown with Narita Brian, hailed as the 
strongest.

Everywhere you went, talks of Narita Brian 
never ceased. Overwhelming in every 
way—the hero everyone had been waiting 
for. It was something that everyone 
acknowledged.

Even before the race, Sakura Laurel could 
feel the overwhelming might of the 
strongest. To defeat the one she admired, 
she put all her strength into her legs and 
challenged her.
